entities.name: Silver Sea
entities.description: A long, narrow inland sea on the island of Almaaz in the Terisian Isles of Dominaria, later submerged beneath the Lat-Nam Straits.

entities.name: Almaaz
entities.description: Island in the Terisian Isles of Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane containing the Terisian Isles.

entities.name: Lat-Nam Straits
entities.description: Waters that eventually submerged the Silver Sea.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: The end of the Ice Age, during which the Silver Sea came into being.

entities.name: Drufalen
entities.description: An ice sorceress who cast a spell locking the Borderlands' water into an icy realm.

entities.name: Borderlands
entities.description: Region frozen by Drufalen's cold kingdom, later made an island.

entities.name: Sarrazan River
entities.description: River whose waters shrank as Drufalen's kingdom grew and rose again after the melting.

entities.name: Wyrvil
entities.description: Neighboring orc kingdom separated from the Borderlands by the Silver Sea.

entities.name: Rotapan
entities.description: Half-orc overking whose domain lay on the border of the Silver Sea.

entities.name: Chelydrus
entities.description: Elusive sea drake worshipped by Rotapan.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: A songmage who melted Drufalen's ice realm with song magic in 3050 AR.

events.summary: During the Thaw, Drufalen casts a spell locking the Borderlands' water into an icy realm, creating the Silver Sea.
events.quote: cast a spell that would lock the water of the Borderlands into an icy realm

events.summary: Sea levels fall, connecting the Borderlands with Almaaz and creating the Silver Sea in the middle.
events.quote: while also creating the Silver Sea in the middle

events.summary: Rotapan makes his domain on the Silver Sea's border, worshipping the sea drake Chelydrus.
events.quote: worshipping an elusive sea drake named Chelydrus

events.summary: Ogwater Rifkin releases the ice's hold on Drufalen's realm with song magic, causing a massive melting that floods the Silver Sea.
events.quote: released the hold of the ice on her realm through song magic

events.summary: Meltwater connects the Silver Sea to the ocean and submerges it beneath the Lat-Nam Straits; the sea is lost.
events.quote: The Silver Sea thus joined the greater ocean and was lost.

relations.quote: The Silver Sea was a long, narrow inland sea on the island of Almaaz

relations.note: her spell caused the sea to form
relations.quote: The Silver Sea came into being during the Thaw
worshipping an elusive sea drake named Chelydrus

relations.note: undid her ice realm with song magic
relations.quote: released the hold of the ice on her realm through song magic
